title: FX Brief — 13 Aug 2026
intro:
Broad USD strength dominates Asian session as safe-haven flows and yield dynamics pressure commodity currencies and yen crosses.
💪 CURRENCY RANKING
1. USD +0.29% — Safe-haven demand and yield support driving across-the-board gains
2. CHF +0.18% — Defensive positioning benefiting Swiss franc amid risk-off undertones
3. EUR -0.11% — Modest weakness against USD but holding ground versus sterling and commodity bloc
4. GBP -0.20% — Cable pressured below 1.35 as USD strength outweighs recent settle gains
5. JPY -0.35% — Continued weakness despite intervention zone proximity, USD/JPY above 159
6. AUD -0.44% — Commodity currency underperformance accelerating on China growth concerns
7. CAD -0.45% — Loonie slides despite prior session strength, oil price correlation weighing
8. NZD -0.81% — Steepest decline as risk aversion hammers high-beta kiwi dollar

sections.heading: 🎯 TRADE IDEAS
sections.content:
LONG:
USD/JPY | 159.30 | 158.50 | 160.50 | Yield differential and momentum favour dollar despite intervention risk
USD/CAD | 1.3955 | 1.3900 | 1.4050 | USD strength overriding oil support for loonie
SHORT:
NZD/USD | 0.5832 | 0.5870 | 0.5750 | Risk aversion punishing high-beta currencies hardest

sections.heading: ⚠️ RISKS
sections.content: USD/JPY intervention above 160.00 could trigger sharp reversal. Surprise China stimulus announcement would immediately reverse commodity currency weakness and unwind safe-haven positioning.
